droid-monkey attacked this Android app with a real-world fault and it failed. Fix the root cause.

## What happened
Attack `rotation` (rotation): Rotate the device while work started by a tap is still running, or on a filled form.
Steps: [{"fill": true}, {"tap": "product_1"}, {"wait": 1.2}, {"fault": "rotate"}, {"settle": 8.0}]
Result: crashed: java.lang.IllegalStateException: FragmentManager has been destroyed
Crash: java.lang.IllegalStateException @ com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui.DealLoader$load$1.invokeSuspend(DetailScreen.kt:64)
  at com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui.DealLoader$load$1.invokeSuspend(DetailScreen.kt:64)

## Diagnosis
Root cause: DetailScreen's LaunchedEffect calls DealLoader.load(activity, ...) (DetailScreen.kt:74-75), which launches on GlobalScope (DetailScreen.kt:58), so the coroutine is not cancelled when the composition leaves. MainActivity keeps the Detail route in rememberSaveable (MainActivity.kt:62), so after rotation the new activity relaunches the load while the old coroutine is still running against the old activity. When that coroutine resumes after the 1.2s wait, it calls show() on the destroyed activity's supportFragmentManager (DetailScreen.kt:64), which throws 'FragmentManager has been destroyed'.
Fix approach: Remove GlobalScope and the captured FragmentActivity from DealLoader. Load the product in a lifecycle-bound scope (LaunchedEffect or a ViewModel's viewModelScope) so it is cancelled on rotation. Hold the deal message in state that survives configuration change (rememberSaveable or a ViewModel field) and render it with a Compose AlertDialog, which removes the DialogFragment/FragmentManager dependency. Stop casting LocalContext to FragmentActivity.
Evidence: app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/DetailScreen.kt:58 - DealLoader.load launches on GlobalScope.launch(Dispatchers.Main), so the coroutine is not tied to any lifecycle or composition; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/DetailScreen.kt:57 - load takes the FragmentActivity and captures it in the long-running coroutine; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/DetailScreen.kt:64 - show(activity.supportFragmentManager) runs after the await, on the activity captured before rotation; the crash frame is here; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/DetailScreen.kt:72 - LocalContext cast to FragmentActivity, the same stale activity reference; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/DetailScreen.kt:74-75 - LaunchedEffect(productId) relaunches DealLoader.load on each new composition, which is why the rotated activity starts a second load; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/MainActivity.kt:62 - the route is kept in rememberSaveable, so the Detail screen is rebuilt after rotation while the old load is still pending; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/MainActivity.kt:79 - DetailScreen is rendered for Route.Detail after recreation, with no cancellation of the previous load

## Files to change
- app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/DetailScreen.kt

## Regression test
Add an instrumented test class DetailScreenRotationTest in src/androidTest. It opens the detail route for a product with a deal, recreates the activity (rotation) while the load is still in flight, and then asserts that no IllegalStateException is thrown, that detail_name is displayed, and that the deal popup appears exactly once. Before the fix it fails with 'FragmentManager has been destroyed'; after the fix it passes.

## Rules
- Fix the root cause in the files above with the idiomatic Android approach. Keep the change small and focused.
- Add exactly one regression test file under app/src/test (JVM unit test, preferred) or app/src/androidTest
  (instrumented), using only test libraries the project already has (see app/build.gradle.kts). It must fail on
  the old code and pass on the fixed code.
- Do not change build files or add dependencies. Do not touch unrelated code. Do not commit.
- Before you finish, call the compile tool on your test ('unit' or 'instrumented') and fix every error it reports.
- When done, reply with one short paragraph: what you changed and the test class name.

addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- claude-code-guide: Use this agent when the user asks questions ("Can Claude...", "Does Claude...", "How do I...") about: (1) Claude Code (the CLI tool) - features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations, keyboard shortcuts; (2) Claude Agent SDK - building custom agents; (3) Claude API (formerly Anthropic API) - API usage, tool use, Anthropic SDK usage. **IMPORTANT:** Before spawning a new agent, check if there is already a running or recently completed claude-code-guide agent that you can continue via SendMessage. (Tools: Bash, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- Explore: Fast read-only search agent for locating code. Use it to find files by pattern (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), grep for symbols or keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer "where is X defined / which files reference Y." Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. When calling, specify search breadth: "quick" for a single targeted lookup, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" to search across multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

40	class DealDialogFragment : DialogFragment() {
41	    override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog =
42	        AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
43	            .setTitle("Deal unlocked")
44	            .setMessage(requireArguments().getString(ARG_MESSAGE))
45	            .setPositiveButton("Nice", null)
46	            .create()
47	
48	    companion object {
49	        private const val ARG_MESSAGE = "message"
50	        fun newInstance(message: String) = DealDialogFragment().apply { arguments = bundleOf(ARG_MESSAGE to message) }
51	    }
52	}

54	/** Loads a product's detail and announces today's deal in a popup. */
55	@OptIn(DelicateCoroutinesApi::class)
56	object DealLoader {
57	    fun load(activity: FragmentActivity, productId: Int, onLoaded: (Product) -> Unit) {
58	        GlobalScope.launch(Dispatchers.Main) {
59	            val product = ProductRepository.byId(productId)
60	            onLoaded(product)
61	            if (product.dealPercent > 0) {
62	                DealDialogFragment
63	                    .newInstance("${product.dealPercent}% off ${product.name}, today only.")
64	                    .show(activity.supportFragmentManager, "deal")
65	            }
66	        }
67	    }
68	}

71	fun DetailScreen(productId: Int, onBuyNow: (Int) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {

73	    var product by remember { mutableStateOf<Product?>(null) }
74	    LaunchedEffect(productId) {
75	        DealLoader.load(activity, productId) { product = it }
76	    }
77

28	class MainActivity : FragmentActivity() {
29	    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
30	        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
31	        enableEdgeToEdge()
32	        setContent {
33	            MonkeyMartTheme {
34	                MonkeyMartApp()
35	            }
36	        }
37	    }
38	}
39	
40	/** Screens are addressed by a small route string so the back stack survives recreation. */
41	sealed interface Route {
42	    data object Shop : Route
43	    data class Detail(val productId: Int) : Route
44	    data class Checkout(val productId: Int) : Route
45	}
46	
47	private fun Route.encode(): String = when (this) {
48	    Route.Shop -> "shop"
49	    is Route.Detail -> "detail:$productId"
50	    is Route.Checkout -> "checkout:$productId"
51	}
52	
53	private fun decodeRoute(raw: String): Route = when {
54	    raw.startsWith("detail:") -> Route.Detail(raw.removePrefix("detail:").toInt())
55	    raw.startsWith("checkout:") -> Route.Checkout(raw.removePrefix("checkout:").toInt())
56	    else -> Route.Shop
57	}
58	
59	@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class, ExperimentalComposeUiApi::class)
60	@Composable
61	fun MonkeyMartApp() {
62	    var rawRoute by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(Route.Shop.encode()) }
63	    val route = decodeRoute(rawRoute)
64	    fun go(to: Route) { rawRoute = to.encode() }
65	
66	    BackHandler(enabled = route != Route.Shop) {
67	        go(if (route is Route.Checkout) Route.Detail(route.productId) else Route.Shop)
68	    }
69	
70	    Scaffold(
71	        modifier = Modifier
72	            .fillMaxSize()
73	            .semantics { testTagsAsResourceId = true },
74	        topBar = { TopAppBar(title = { Text("MonkeyMart") }) },
75	    ) { padding ->
76	        val content = Modifier.padding(padding)
77	        when (route) {
78	            Route.Shop -> ShopScreen(onProductClick = { go(Route.Detail(it)) }, modifier = content)
79	            is Route.Detail -> DetailScreen(route.productId, onBuyNow = { go(Route.Checkout(it)) }, modifier = content)
80	            is Route.Checkout -> CheckoutScreen(route.productId, modifier = content)
81	        }
82	    }
83	}

        }
        return
    }

    Column(
        modifier = modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp).testTag("detail_screen"),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,

    }
}

content.text:
I fixed the rotation crash in `DetailScreen.kt` and added the regression test `DetailScreenRotationTest`. The instrumented test compiles, but I haven't run it on a device, so I haven't confirmed that it fails on the old code and passes on the new.

- **The fix:** I removed `DealLoader` and `DealDialogFragment`, along with `GlobalScope` and the cast of `LocalContext` to `FragmentActivity`. The product now loads in the `LaunchedEffect`, so rotation cancels it. The deal message and an "already announced" flag are held with `rememberSaveable`, and a Compose `AlertDialog` shows the message.
- **Behaviour change:** The load still takes 5 seconds, and it restarts after rotation. The saved "announced" flag keeps the deal popup from appearing a second time.
- **The test:** It opens the detail route for product 1, waits 1.2s, then recreates the activity. It then checks that `detail_name` is displayed and that exactly one "Deal unlocked" popup is on screen.
